CVS Health, posted pay on its open jobs as of 2026-10-19: typical $25 to $90/hr, median $30/hr (from 462 distinct posted hourly rates; 556 of the 5,655 open jobs post no hourly rate). Its median mixes every kind of job it has open.
By kind of job: Pharmacy typical $20 to $85/hr, median $25/hr (298 rates, 5,129 open jobs); Nurses typical $40 to $70/hr, median $40/hr (40 rates, 160 open jobs); NPs & PAs typical $60 to $100/hr, median $65/hr (59 rates, 158 open jobs); Front desk & admin typical $20 to $35/hr, median $25/hr (18 rates, 56 open jobs); Doctors typical $125 to $180/hr, median $130/hr (14 rates, 53 open jobs); Medical assistants typical $25 to $40/hr, median $30/hr (10 rates, 35 open jobs); Mental health typical $25 to $55/hr, median $25/hr (5 rates, 35 open jobs); Allied health typical $25 to $40/hr, median $30/hr (11 rates, 19 open jobs); Lab typical $25 to $40/hr, median $30/hr (6 rates, 9 open jobs).
Its jobs by pay: https://carejobs.now/?platform=cvs-health&sort=pay&country=all#live-roles. Its pay: https://carejobs.now/employers/cvs-health#pay. Typical pay is the 25th percentile of what jobs pay (the middle of each advertised range) to the 90th-percentile advertised ceiling. Method: https://carejobs.now/methodology.
